about.description:
AdaptiveCpp is the independent, community-driven modern platform for
C++-based heterogeneous programming models targeting CPUs and GPUs from all
major vendors. AdaptiveCpp lets applications adapt themselves to all the
hardware found in the system. This includes use cases where a single binary
needs to be able to target all supported hardware, or utilize hardware from
different vendors simultaneously.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: AdaptiveCpp
  version: "25.10.0"
  build_number: 10

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 334b16ebff373bd2841f83332c2ae9a45ec192f2cf964d5fdfe94e1140776059
    patches:
      # Drop once upstream installs the llvm-to-backend tools next to their
      # libraries, or gives the upstream bin/ layout a working relocatable RPATH.
      - if: linux
        then: patches/0001-Install-tool-binaries-to-the-same-folder-of-lib.patch
      # Drop once the packaged release includes AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp#1956.
      - if: linux
        then: patches/0002-Fall-back-missing-functions.patch
      # Drop once upstream supports an offline external OpenCL header setup and
      # an externally supplied AdaptiveCpp SPIR-V translator source (see
      # AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp#1611).
      - if: linux
        then: patches/0003-Use-packaged-dependency-sources.patch
      # Drop this downstream patch once AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp#2185 is merged
      # and the packaged AdaptiveCpp release includes the fix.
      - if: linux
        then: patches/0004-Cross-compile-native-bitcode-tools.patch
  # AdaptiveCpp's translator fork has required address-space handling from
  # AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp#1825; conda-forge's llvm-spirv is not interchangeable.
  - if: linux and llvm_version == "16"
    then:
      url: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/SPIRV-LLVM-Translator/archive/d678e6a2a95849c9985c8d209f67b318999083c6.tar.gz
      sha256: cabeb13932480edeb53e07797165b2a29ffe9fff82701504e6bb9b9e605c8e64
      target_directory: acpp-spirv-llvm-translator
  - if: linux and llvm_version == "17"
    then:
      url: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/SPIRV-LLVM-Translator/archive/21d3f7deabd85dcdebd207d8dc75958ab902e4a4.tar.gz
      sha256: b227a5adb4590ba28dd5fa612b96f732847d4b5c6019b4fd94c7397f4ee7b1e9
      target_directory: acpp-spirv-llvm-translator
  - if: linux and llvm_version == "18"
    then:
      url: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/SPIRV-LLVM-Translator/archive/530c950568ce80137e1c0876d9afc403455a3cb6.tar.gz
      sha256: 4d52536344fe0a4962380ab0316db7e5f35cd218d8fcbdf0c795a7eb57302574
      target_directory: acpp-spirv-llvm-translator
  - if: linux and llvm_version == "19"
    then:
      url: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/SPIRV-LLVM-Translator/archive/ed04cf4540ec8b1cda2921c3f2eabc72a9291465.tar.gz
      sha256: 9098743b0b0e759b02e3e4e1efc1931f51bed87b89296dada072a0eedeb1a06a
      target_directory: acpp-spirv-llvm-translator
  # OpenCL-CLHPP is not packaged by conda-forge, so provide its source offline.
  - if: linux
    then:
      url: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-CLHPP/archive/67d100e70612341707725b6648ccca4c10b0dc31.tar.gz
      sha256: a6112af8ba2cc8a5248bcc7399624258cb9609b31ccd4a65222bf61893c2c618
      target_directory: opencl-clhpp

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "")) ~ "_llvm" ~ llvm_version ~ "_h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu_llvm" ~ llvm_version ~ "_h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win and cuda_compiler_version == "13.0"
  script:
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: win
        then: "*/nvcuda.dll"
      - if: linux
        then: "*/libcuda.so.1"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - if: not win
      then: ninja
    - if: linux
      then: pkg-config
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and build_platform != target_platform
      then: cuda-cudart-dev
    # Cross builds compile the device bitcode with build-native clang/llvm-link
    # (see ACPP_BITCODE_* in build.sh).
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and linux
      then: clangdev ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and linux
      then: llvm-tools ${{ llvm_version }}.*
  host:
    - clangdev
    - if: linux and x86_64
      then: hipcc
    - if: not win
      then: lld ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - llvmdev ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - llvm-openmp ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    # AdaptiveCpp enables NUMA support when the headers and library are present.
    - if: linux
      then: libnuma
    - if: linux
      then: libopencl-devel
    - if: linux and x86_64
      then: rocm-device-libs
    - if: linux
      then: spirv-headers
    # The bundled translator links to SPIRV-Tools; use conda-forge's global pin
    # and the package's run export to keep the runtime ABI compatible.
    - if: linux
      then: spirv-tools
    # cuda-compat is needed for libcuda.so.1
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
      then: cuda-compat
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-cudart-dev
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
      then: cuda-driver-dev
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
      then: cuda-nvvm-tools
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
  run:
    - if: osx and x86_64
      then: clangdev ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - if: osx and arm64
      then: clangdev
    # The acpp driver defaults to the clang++ installed by clangxx.
    - if: linux
      then: clangxx ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - if: linux and x86_64
      then: hip-runtime-amd
    - if: not win
      then: lld ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - libllvm${{ llvm_version }}
    - llvm ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    # The generic/OpenMP runtime JIT invokes opt/llc from the matching LLVM.
    - if: not win
      then: llvm-tools ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp ${{ llvm_version }}.*
    - if: linux and x86_64
      then: rocm-device-libs
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
      then: cuda-nvvm-tools
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("adaptivecpp", upper_bound="x.x") }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - llvm
      - if: not win
        then: llvm-openmp

tests:
  - files:
      recipe:
        - run_cmake_test.bat
        - run_cmake_test.sh
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: not linux
          then: clangdev
        # Test-only CUDA headers let CI compile a CMake AdaptiveCpp CUDA target without a GPU.
        - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
          then: cuda-crt
        - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
          then: cuda-cudart-dev
        - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
          then: cuda-driver-dev
        - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
          then: cuda-nvcc-tools
        - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
          then: libcurand-dev
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: ninja
    script:
      - if: not win
        then: test -f $PREFIX/include/AdaptiveCpp/sycl/sycl.hpp
      - if: not win
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/cmake/AdaptiveCpp/adaptivecpp-config.cmake
      - if: not win
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/libacpp-common${SHLIB_EXT}
      - if: not win
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/librt-backend-omp${SHLIB_EXT}
      - if: linux
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/librt-backend-ocl${SHLIB_EXT}
      - if: linux and x86_64
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/librt-backend-hip${SHLIB_EXT}
      - if: linux
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/bitcode/libkernel-sscp-host-full.bc
      - if: linux
        then: test ! -e $PREFIX/lib/lib/hipSYCL/bitcode/libkernel-sscp-host-full.bc
      - if: linux
        then: test -x $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/llvm-to-backend/llvm-to-spirv-tool
      - if: linux
        then: test -x $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/ext/llvm-spirv/bin/llvm-spirv
      - if: linux
        then: $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/ext/llvm-spirv/bin/llvm-spirv --version
      - if: osx and x86_64
        then: test -x $PREFIX/bin/clang++
      - if: osx and x86_64
        then: '! grep -R "_build_env.*/.*clang" $PREFIX/etc/AdaptiveCpp/acpp-core.json'
      - if: linux
        then: test -x $PREFIX/bin/clang++-${{ llvm_version }} || test -x $PREFIX/bin/clang++
      - if: linux
        then: test -x $PREFIX/bin/opt-${{ llvm_version }} || test -x $PREFIX/bin/opt
      - if: linux
        then: test -x $PREFIX/bin/llc-${{ llvm_version }} || test -x $PREFIX/bin/llc
      - if: linux
        then: '! grep -R "_build_env.*/nvvm/libdevice\|/lib/lib/hipSYCL/bitcode" $PREFIX/etc/AdaptiveCpp $PREFIX/lib/cmake/AdaptiveCpp'
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and not win
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/librt-backend-cuda${SHLIB_EXT}
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
        then: test -f $PREFIX/nvvm/libdevice/libdevice.10.bc
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
        then: test -L $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/ext/bitcode/ptx/libdevice.10.bc
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and linux
        then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/hipSYCL/ext/bitcode/ptx/libdevice.10.bc
      - if: not win
        then: bash run_cmake_test.sh
      - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
        then: cmake -S tests/cmake-cuda-smoke -B test-build-cuda -G Ninja -DACPP_TARGETS=cuda:sm_80
      - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version == "12.9" and llvm_version == "19"
        then: cmake --build test-build-cuda
      - if: not win
        then: acpp-info
      - if: linux and x86_64 and cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then: cmake -S tests -B test-build -G Ninja
      - if: linux and x86_64 and cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then: cmake --build test-build
      - if: linux and x86_64 and cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then: ACPP_VISIBILITY_MASK=omp ./test-build/adaptivecpp-example
      - if: win
        then:
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\include\AdaptiveCpp\SYCL\sycl.hpp exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\cmake\AdaptiveCpp\adaptivecpp-config.cmake exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\acpp-common.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\bin\acpp-common.dll exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\hipSYCL\rt-backend-omp.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\bin\hipSYCL\rt-backend-omp.dll exit 1
          - call run_cmake_test.bat
          - acpp-info.exe
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and win
        then:
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\hipSYCL\rt-backend-cuda.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\bin\hipSYCL\rt-backend-cuda.dll exit 1

about:
  homepage: https://adaptivecpp.github.io/
  summary: The independent, community-driven platform for heterogeneous programming in C++
  description: |
    AdaptiveCpp is the independent, community-driven modern platform for
    C++-based heterogeneous programming models targeting CPUs and GPUs from all
    major vendors. AdaptiveCpp lets applications adapt themselves to all the
    hardware found in the system. This includes use cases where a single binary
    needs to be able to target all supported hardware, or utilize hardware from
    different vendors simultaneously.
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/AdaptiveCpp/AdaptiveCpp
